entries.title: Read from the keyboard what resting the pointer shows
entries.body: Tab now reaches the details Firstmate used to show only under a resting pointer: when an allowance resets, what ✱ and the firstmate tag mean beside an account, why a provider can't be connected yet, a folder path too long to fit, and the exact time behind a task's short ages. The keyboard brings up the same label the pointer does, Esc puts it away, and screen readers read the same words.

picture.alt: Settings, Intelligence: the keyboard on a Codex account's weekly allowance, ringed, with the label weekly · resets Fri under it
